description: Buy and download the Overnight Chief of Staff Setup Pack ($9 USDC on Base via x402): 5 ready-to-paste bot prompts, an HTML morning-briefing template, and a PDF setup guide. Always paid — no free quota. Call without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to receive payment requirements and the HTTP endpoint URL. Agents pay by retrying the HTTP endpoint (or this MCP call) with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header holding a signed USDC EIP-3009 authorization.
name: get_overnight_cos_pack
